content: Ads not closeable without closing app. When adds appear, usually have to turn sound off if listening to something. Main issue is that too many ads cannot be closed without closing to app. Wasted time.
Not working. I’ve just wanted to start using this app to track my expenses and it’s not working. I tried multiple times to add a transaction but it can’t be added. Useless app, not updated in a year.
Worthless. I think the people behind this app don’t know how budgeting works
Don’t. Started to use this tracker and within 15 minutes got a message my iPad was corrupted beyond belief and to d/l a new app to fix it….
Paid Subscription. Cannot use without upgrade
Viruses. The apps was launching viruses on my phone
No Font size. No option to change the font size, no Arial nor Time new Roman formatting
Ads. It’s really pointless when you can’t use the app due to all the pop up adds covering the features needed to enter your expenses and income.
Full screen ads. The full screen ads are really a no go for me. The app isn't worth that.
Ad infested. Ad infested, so while it’s advertised as a “free” app, it makes you pay with ads that interrupt the function of the app. Inconvenient.
Can’t X out of ads to access your data. Advertising gets stuck ‘on’ and there’s no way to access your data. Can’t X out of ads.
Ads, age inappropriate…. Bare naked models showing, unable to get out of ads when it’s shown full screen.

Ads you can’t exit. I was ready to give a five star!  Then an ad popped up. No biggie!  Right?

Wrong!  

I was not allowed to exit until this ad for a game, I will never in my life play, was finished torturing me.

I hate that.  For that reason alone I’m removing the app and no longer interested in this company’s other budget apps I sorely need.

I guess I’ll have to pay the big bucks for a [APP] program or something.

I HATE FORCED ADS!

For me it really hurts a company’s ability to showcase a reasonably priced product.

No I won’t pay for a phone app until I know I like it and it works!

I was ready to buy and check out other products.

Give me a way to close out of an ad and I will be willing to pay to get rid of ads altogether.

But when I’m forced to watch. Deal breaker.

I pay extra to stream ad free.  I at least get to see what I’m streaming before I’m forced to make a decision.
